minutes_text:
CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS  Tuesday, March 21, 2023
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENTS  Special Meeting, 5:30 PM
COMMITTEE MINUTES

Luis Roa, Co-Director  Maria Teresa Del Rio,  Ernesto Marquez, City Manager
  Mayor  Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager

  MINUTES
CALL TO ORDER

The Capital Improvements Committee meeting was called to order on Tuesday, March 21, 2023 at
5:33 PM.

ROLL CALL
PRESENT

  Maria Teresa Del Rio, Co-Director
  Luis Roa, Co-Director

Also present: Ernesto Marquez, City Manager; Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
There were no Public Comments.

DISCUSSION ITEM(S)
 1.  Proposed Projects for Fiscal Year 2023-2024 and Fiscal Year 2024-2025.

  Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, provided an overview to the committee members of
  the proposed projects:
  City Hall Modernization; Public Works Maintenance Yard Remodel; FY 2023-24 Arterial &
  Residential Streets Rehabilitation; Citywide Sidewalk Improvements; FY 2024-25 Street
  Improvements; Crosswalk Pedestrian Safety Enhancement on Norwalk Blvd; City Hall Building
  Roof Replacement; Helen Rosas Center Elevator Modernization; Carson St Beautification
  Phase II; Carson St Improvements - Pioneer to Norwalk; Joliet/Civic Center Parkway Project; C.
  Robert lee HVAC Replacement; City Hall Restroom Renovations; Clarkdale Park
  Enhancements; Engineering Reports; C. Robert Lee Center Renovations; and Ferguson
  Elementary School Sports Field Improvements.

NEW BUSINESS
There were no New Business Items.

ADJOURNMENT
The Capital Improvements Committee meeting was adjourned at 6:37 PM.
